bio: The Exchequer is an award-winning pub in Crookham Village near Fleet, Hampshire.  Indulge in one of Britain’s most loved traditions with Afternoon Tea in the warming surrounds of the restaurant. A delectable selection of sweet treats and savoury delights await, complete with freshly baked scones, clotted cream and preserves.  The spacious patio area is ideal for soaking up some summer sun after a local dog walk, while the cosy fire and blend of modern design with traditional country pub décor make it the perfect hideaway.  Afternoon Tea is served Monday to Saturday, 12pm to 5pm and advance booking is recommended.
